Featured label

One Love Records

One Love Records was founded by the late Chicago legend Paul Johnson, the producer behind "Get Get Down," and Dutch producer Alex Pi, built on a 20 year friendship and one shared love, the music. The label puts out authentic house, rhythmic tech house and bass heavy techno from artists rooted in the genres' birthplaces.

Founded by the late Paul Johnson ("Get Get Down") and Dutch producer Alex Pi, One Love Records champions authentic house, tech house and bass heavy techno from the genres' birthplaces.

About

House music is made on the floor. We follow the DJs, labels and rooms shaping it across Los Angeles and Southern California, so you always know where to be.

HOUSE·LA is an independent guide to house music in Los Angeles and Southern California. Headliners, weeklies, day parties and festivals in one list, checked against venue and promoter calendars, plus new music from local DJs and labels. Deep, melodic, afro, tech.
